articles.summary: I guess the problem needs no introduction. Blind signing has been a big pain, arguably the biggest UX pain, of Ethereum since its inception. It's just not possible for humans to know what they are about to sign and authorize on their wallets. Any step compromised on the transaction/signature supply chain can cause a malicious signature to enter your wallet and you unknowingly approve a transaction that drains your funds.
articles.title: Introduction to ERC-7730: Clear Signing for Ethereum
